features.evidence: 原现场证据 0f5b483/台账（四十一）仍硬停。N4-R1 离线修复和 fake IPC/journal 响应回程测试通过，N4-R2 callback capture、固定-hash 1DB2 pair release/body input ownership、context 发布前 PIN bridge image、resident stop 映射时不再发布业务事件。固定 hash callback manager op 0–3 双表分支已静态映射；2026-10-13 进一步核实 73BD6C user invoker 为五参并将 consumer_invoke 对齐（见寿命合同 §7.2–7.3 与执行记录）。`HttpConnection+0xA0` owner/capture 与 accepted HttpServer 路径的 `HttpConnection+0x38`=`TCPClientSocket@xpng`、内层 `TCPSocketLibuv@xpng` slot 8 `0x31F729E` 现见寿命合同 §7.8–7.10；该 generic HTTP socket 路径不证明 QQ response consumer。op=1/op=3 assignment 证据、op=2 callers、HttpServer 替代 wrapper 弱 owner、R8D 精确查找/erase 与 `+0x5C` 自增 key→wrapper capture→`+0x20` 命中删除的局部回路见寿命合同 §7.11–§7.13；NTEngine parent 字段 release edge 及与 child+0x110 manager holder 的偏移区分见 §7.14；child destructor 的 run_loop_thread.cc stop 虚调用、index-0 task-vector 选择与 INFINITE wait/CloseHandle 路径见 §7.15–§7.16；§7.16 已把固定样本 `D31686→D33418→CreateThread` 成功返回的 HANDLE 绑定到 `child+0x10`；wait result 仍被忽略，不能证明 thread exit、manager 全任务停止或 QQ callback drain/quiescence。manager vector 的 `TaskQueue` pair 经 slot 1/`0x63EC4` 投影后，index-0 task wrapper RTTI 为 `TaskRunner@TaskQueue@internal@xpng`；其 `+0x8/+0x10` pair pointee 为 `ThreadTaskManagerImpl`，slot0/slot2 通过该 pair 使用 manager-owned `+0x58` 作线程 ID 比较，slot3 也检查该字段（寿命合同 §7.17）。ThreadTaskManager 字段及 TLS source 更正见寿命合同 §7.18 / thread contract §13：`+0x30/+0x38` 是 pair、`+0x40` 是 holder pointer；slot2 从 `+0x30` pointee 复制其 `+0x38/+0x40` pair 并安装到 TLS，slot3 也从该 pointee 投影。TaskRunner TID mismatch 路径则直接从 manager `+0x38/+0x40` 作 pair-shaped projection，字段跨越上述 pair 与 holder pointer，不能称为已识别的 manager pair，也不能识别 nested `D32138` 目标；相关 RTTI/运行时语义仍 unknown，不证明全项 stop 或 drain/quiescence。外层 last-owner、payload 类型/调用点、该 key 与协议身份的关系、动态全局 manager、owner/consumer thread、stable identity、历史 AV 与现场回程仍未闭合。寿命合同 §7.19 / thread contract §14 已确认 manager `+0x30` 的条件 pair writer 与 source construction chain；两个静态调用路径的 bound/selector 为 3/1 与 1/0 且都会命中 writer；RTTI 指向 TaskQueue。此前仅两条配置输入已复原；现固定-hash 静态复核覆盖全部 30 个可识别直接 E8 callsite：28 个为默认 `{0,0,0,0,1,0}`（bound=1/selector=0），1 个 `01B63FF7` 由 `D324EC` 写出同模板，1 个 `09C0EE1` 为 `{0,0,0,0,3,1}`（bound=3/selector=1），均使 `217D58C` writer 条件静态可达。此结果不证明现场执行或与 T1–T5 manager 的映射，间接调用仍未覆盖；slot2/slot3 全局顺序、owner teardown/quiescence、R3 identity、历史 AV 与现场回程仍未闭合。2026-10-14 寿命合同 §7.26 识别 TLS detach callback dispatch 与 HeapFree 节点释放；50 个函数/参数状态的有界扫描仍未定位 TLS+0xB0 producer。§7.27 识别条件性 NTEngine +0xE0 → child dtor → child+0x110 manager-holder release；§7.28 又识别 MSFThread_xpng slot-2 setup 将 manager holder 放入 inner payload +0x110，并由 wrapper deleting destructor 回到 D31356。外部 payload 构造目标 0x180D30FF0 未绑定模块/hash；实际 finalizer、manager last strong owner、全局 stop/drain/quiescence 与 consumer ABI/thread 仍 unknown。未做新现场验收，继续 blocked。 2026-10-14 fixed-hash R2 supplement: RTTI maps ThreadPoolImpl slot 2 to D31686 setup at +0xA0 and conditional slot-0 cleanup calls D313D6 before pair reset; runtime trigger, last strong owner, successful wait, global callback quiescence, and R3 identity remain unknown. 2026-10-14 fixed-hash R2 follow-up: RTTI maps FileDragManagerWin slot 2 to D31686 on child owner field +0xA8, and slot-0 cleanup conditionally reaches D31356 before freeing it; runtime instance, manager last owner, successful wait, global callback quiescence, and consumer ABI/thread remain unknown. 2026-10-15 offline R2 matrix adds op 0/1/3/4 plus bounded span, quarantine, isolated unreadable-pointer, and inline-submit cases; the research/default validation gates pass after adding explicit daemon bridge-ready synchronization. These synthetic checks do not resolve the historical 0xC0000005 or static QQ ABI/thread/owner gates.
